usage: valvur [-h] [--version]
              {scan,update,findings,explain,status,doctor,gate,cache,suppress} ...

Command line interface.

positional arguments:
  {scan,update,findings,explain,status,doctor,gate,cache,suppress}
    scan                Scan a workspace
    update              Pull the image if it is not local, and fetch the vulnerability database
                        and the package-name index into the local cache
    findings            List findings from the last scan
    explain             Explain one finding in full
    status              What the last scan actually did
    doctor              Check that this machine can scan — runtime, image, database, index,
                        SELinux, TLS trust, MCP client configuration — and say what to fix
    gate                Exit 1 if the last scan's results should not ship: an incomplete run, a
                        lapsed suppression, or an active finding at or above --fail-on. For CI.
    cache               What is in the host cache, how old and how large; --clear removes it
    suppress            Print a ready-to-paste suppression block for a finding (never writes)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
